S.FORM: alang Rangay ga niya mki sku Toweng si atu Hosing Ku, kwara sali buwan nya ga 20 buwan, 56 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 98% kyan ku 55 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 2% kyan ku 1 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 91%, binah lihuyan s'uli 7%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Rangay hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Rangay hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Rangay hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Rangay hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Rangay hya' ga Kinyawpan. tay 'llaw na Rangay hya' ga Triqan. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ raŋaj ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku toweŋ [s|ɕ]i atu ħo[s|ɕ]iŋ ku kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan ** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na raŋaj ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na raŋaj ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na raŋaj ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na raŋaj ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na raŋaj ħjaʔ ɣa kinjawpan taj ʔllaw na raŋaj ħjaʔ ɣa triqan reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
